### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**1** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **21** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 33a31dc7b083e1a25310b0323c8cc5d796c3b4b8` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `d18cb79eda7c89e81b2663570dc2c704df02d4a1` — the merge of head `046abbb2e0a91b83b9b257e465662861f00c024d` into base `33a31dc7b083e1a25310b0323c8cc5d796c3b4b8`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin d18cb79eda7c89e81b2663570dc2c704df02d4a1 && git checkout d18cb79eda7c89e81b2663570dc2c704df02d4a1
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 33a31dc7b083e1a25310b0323c8cc5d796c3b4b8 046abbb2e0a91b83b9b257e465662861f00c024d && git checkout -B drift-repro 33a31dc7b083e1a25310b0323c8cc5d796c3b4b8 && git merge --no-ff 046abbb2e0a91b83b9b257e465662861f00c024d

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 33a31dc7b083e1a25310b0323c8cc5d796c3b4b8
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `046abbb2e0a91b83b9b257e465662861f00c024d`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #37440 (body, both triage comments, the claim 7192440976, os-dev-reports 7195557089 and 7197868942); PR #37637 body and all 32 files, net diff merge-base `758e145d50` to head; the check-runs on this head. Cross-read on `main` (read, not reviewed): `PublishMetaItemRequestSchema` in `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`, the per-item publish door in `packages/rest/src/meta-item-history-routes.ts`, `metaSaveRequestOptions` in `packages/rest/src/meta-save-request.ts`, and the draft-pin judgment in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-history-and-publish.ts`.

Gate verdicts at this head: every check-run is completed, `success` or `skipped`, none failed or pending. That includes Test Core 10/10, Test UI 16/16, Type Check UI, TypeScript Type Check, Check Changeset, Lint and Repo Gates, Governed Surface Queue Guard and the PR-body guards.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **`@objectstack/client` `meta.publishItem` adds `draftVersion?: string`: RIGHT.** It matches `PublishMetaItemRequestSchema.draftVersion` (`z.string().optional()`). It goes where the door reads it: the body member `draftVersion` beside `message`, typed as a string, with a non-string refused `400`. The JSDoc's description of the refusal agrees with the schema and with `protocol-history-and-publish.ts`: `409 METADATA_CONFLICT`, `currentVersion` names the draft's token, `null` when no draft is pending, nothing promoted.
2. **`meta.publishItem` adds `parentVersion?: string | null`: RIGHT.** It matches `PublishMetaItemRequestSchema.parentVersion` (`z.string().nullable().optional()`) and the door's carrier, which `metaSaveRequestOptions` reads off the headers. A token is sent verbatim as `If-Match`, as `metaSaveHeaders` sends it. `null` is sent as `If-None-Match: *`. One argument cannot produce both headers, so the door's `400` for that pair cannot be triggered. Absent and `null` stay distinct, as the schema's ⚠️ requires.
3. **An unpinned call is byte-identical to before: RIGHT (read).** The body was `JSON.stringify(opts?.message ? { message } : {})` and is now `JSON.stringify({ ...(message ? { message } : {}), ...(draftVersion ? { draftVersion } : {}) })`. With `draftVersion` unset or empty, both serialise to the same bytes. `metaPublishHeaders` returns `undefined`, never `{}`, when `parentVersion` is unset or `''`, so the `headers` key is left out. `fetch` then gets `{ method, body }`, the same keys in the same order, and the private `fetch` merges the same default headers as before. The query string is unchanged. The client test's CONTROL asserts the same thing on the wire.
4. **`metaPublishHeaders` is module-private: RIGHT.** No new export from `@objectstack/client`.
5. **Real-door coverage: RIGHT.** `meta-publish-item-package.test.ts` Part 3 boots the real publish door. REPRODUCTION: an unpinned publish promotes `theirs`. PIN: refused, with `active:live` and `draft:theirs` kept. CONTROL: an uninterleaved publish promotes. It also covers `parentVersion` stale or `null` being refused and the live token promoting.
6. **`@object-ui/app-shell` (a private package) gets no public-surface change.** `draftVersionGuard.ts` gains `isPublishDraftMoved` and `draftReceiptVersion`, re-exported from `DraftConflictDialog.tsx`, but the package entry exports neither. The behaviour changes at the consumer are RIGHT on reading:
   - Each listed draft-then-publish Save pins its publish to its own draft-save receipt and never to a re-read.
   - Each take-back of that draft is pinned `If-Match` to the same receipt, so a moved draft is kept.
   - Rule 10's classification compares the draft read's `version` with the receipt's `version`. On `main` the read and the receipt serve one derivation of the token, so string equality is the right comparison. A read that cannot classify fails safe: nothing is asked and nothing is discarded.
   - `publishCreated` (create with `If-None-Match: *`) does not classify the refusal. Its discard is pinned to the receipt, so a moved draft is still kept.
7. **No accept-set change on any server door, schema or `packages/spec` file.** `Metadata-protocol: none` is correct.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/37440-draft-publish-pins.md` bumps `@objectstack/client` and `@object-ui/app-shell` at `patch`. The diff publishes an additive, optional option on a non-protocol SDK method, plus console behaviour fixes, with `Metadata-protocol: none`. Under AGENTS.md (Post-Task Checklist step 3), a non-protocol change ships `patch`, so the level is correct. Naming the private app-shell package matches the repo's existing changesets (`privatePackages.version: true`).

The `Clause-②:` line reads `yes (widening: ...)` in both the PR body and the changeset body, line-initial, and agrees with the diff:
- The SDK can now state two pins it could not state before.
- Nothing it could send before is refused or changed: an unpinned call is byte-identical.
- No narrowing arm is owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Round-2 `open_questions`:** empty.
- **Round-1 open questions:** both are answered on the record.
  - Sequencing against #37589: option A was taken. #37589 landed, origin/main was merged in `6f1e7359b3`, and rule 10 now lives in `draftVersionGuard.ts`.
  - Footer: the seat ruled option A, and the body carries the dispatch's lines.
- **Deviations** (round 1: a push before overlap-check, which came back clean right after; one classifier denial): process only, nothing owed by the tree.
- **Out-of-scope callers:**
  - `StudioDesignSurface` `publishDraft('flow')`, `usePublishAllDrafts` and PackagesPage `publishDrafts` are publish-all doors with no draft write of their own, so there is no receipt to pin. This reason holds and meets the card's second Done-when.
  - `boundToPackage` is already pinned.
  - PackageOwdOverviewPanel, deferred in round 1, now pins.
- **Nit N6:** escalated to the seat. The card says it "can ride" and the dev gives a reason it does not: its fix site is ViewConfigPanel / RuntimeDraftBar. But the out-of-scope entry reads "carrier: none · noted, not filed", and `Fixes #37440` closes the only card that records N6. Before landing, the seat should give N6 a carrier (file it, or point to an open card). This does not affect this diff.
- **SQL push-down:** no finding. The only new read is one `getDraft` of a single address. It runs only after a `409` under both pins and only to classify the refusal. There is no id materialisation and no in-app join.

Nits (no effect on correctness or the contract):
- N1. The `parentVersion` JSDoc does not say that `''` is treated as unset and sent as nothing. `metaPublishHeaders` does this, and the `draftVersion` JSDoc says so for its own member.
- N2. `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx` still shows `publishItem` with `message` only. The two pins are documented in the JSDoc and the changeset but not on the SDK page.
- N3. Within `client.meta`, the live-row pin is spelled `ifMatch` on `saveItem` and `deleteItem` but `parentVersion` on `publishItem`. This follows the spec schema and the card's wording. Noted only.
